hero.title: Support, advice, and useful local contacts
hero.paragraph_1: The hub is a friendly starting point for practical help, local opportunities, and community information.
hero.paragraph_2: If you are not sure where to begin, email the hub and we will help point you in the right direction.
hero.card_text: From digital support and family sessions to employment advice and community activities, the hub connects residents with support that matters.

cards.title: Wybourn Works
cards.description: Support with confidence building, skills, and next steps into work.

cards.title: Digital Skills Support
cards.description: Weekly practical help using devices and completing online forms, delivered with Manor & Castle Development Trust.

cards.title: Best Start sessions
cards.description: Parent and toddler activities, creative sessions, and family support during the week.

cards.title: Need pointing in the right direction?
cards.description: Email pmcommunityhub@outlook.com and the hub team can help connect you with the right service or session.

employment.title: Wybourn Works at the hub
employment.paragraph_1: Wybourn Works offers local support around confidence, skills, and employability. If you want to talk through your next step, this is a good place to start.
employment.paragraph_2: You can speak with the team at the hub or email wybournworks@greatplaces.org.uk for more information.
